_meta.description: League-wide per-season averages 1960-1998. Top level = NFL (1960-69 NFL only; AFL in `afl`, team-game-weighted mix in `combined`). 1970+ = merged NFL.
_meta.note: estimated from knowledge of published league averages (e.g. PFR league year-by-year averages); verify

definitions.ypa: gross passing yards / attempts (sack yardage not subtracted), as in passer rating
definitions.passerRating: NFL formula applied to compPct, ypa, tdPct, intPct (derived, not separately estimated)
definitions.pointsPerTeamGame: points scored per team per game
definitions.*PerTeamGame: league per team-game volumes, derived from the rates (e.g. passYds = att x ypa)
definitions.gamesPerTeam: regular-season games per team (1987: 15 incl. 3 replacement games; 1982: 9)

ruleChanges.1966: Falcons join NFL; Dolphins join AFL.
ruleChanges.1972: Hashmarks moved in (23y 1ft 9in from the sidelines) -> rushing up.
ruleChanges.1974: Goalposts to end line, one-chuck rule on receivers; passing still depressed.
ruleChanges.1977: Dead-ball low point: lowest scoring and passer rating of the Super Bowl era. Head slap banned.
ruleChanges.1978: 16 games. Pass-rule changes (contact beyond 5 yards banned, OL may extend hands): passing jumps.
ruleChanges.1979: Full first season under the 1978 rules settles in: passing volume up sharply.
ruleChanges.1982: Players' strike: 9 games per team. First season with official individual sacks.
ruleChanges.1987: Strike: 15 games per team, 3 of them (weeks 4-6) played by replacement players; one week cancelled.
ruleChanges.1994: Two-point conversion, kickoff from the 30, tighter chuck enforcement: passing volume jumps.
